t2.thesis: Zillow will probably beat lowered EPS estimates again, but it has sold off on beats, its traffic is shrinking, and it rallied hard into the print, so the odds of a higher next-day open are slightly below the base rate.
reasons: In the last four prints the stock opened higher only once (25%), and fell after two clear EPS beats of about 15% (-15% and -6% at the open)
The 90-day EPS revision is -12.5%: estimates have been cut, which makes a beat likely but already expected
The stock is up 13% in a month and jumped about 8% on Nov 2 on lower Treasury yields, so the bar for the print is now higher
Traffic fell 2% YoY and management pointed to a slower second half, so guidance risk dominates the reaction
Cost cuts (7% headcount) and the cheap valuation (11x forward P/E, -59% from the 52-week high) give some upside if margin guidance rises
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 guidance for revenue and adjusted EBITDA, especially Residential/Premier Agent growth against a slowing housing market and declining traffic.

prior.from: I3 software_internet cluster t0_hit 0.541 (AMC session 0.538; overall ~0.54)

t2.moved_from_prior: I moved down about 7 points from 0.54 to 0.47. I took off roughly 4 points for the pattern of selling off on beats plus falling estimates, roughly 3 points for the pre-print run-up driven by yields, and added back about 1 point for cost-cut margin upside and the low valuation.
